item.title: sageroute
item.description:
Trajectory-aware model router. An OpenAI-compatible proxy that starts every task on a cheap model, watches what the agent actually does, and escalates on real execution evidence via the Levanto Sage API.
This various technologies project caught my attention for its practical approach to solving real developer problems. The codebase offers patterns worth studying for anyone working in this space.

item.title: model serving minefield
item.description:
The Problem
LLM serving stacks produce confidently wrong measurements—latency, throughput, accuracy—because of subtle bugs in chat templates, tool parsers, reasoning field stripping, quantization kernel paths, CUDA toolchain mismatches, KV cache allocation, and eval harness configuration. These bugs look like model problems, cost hours of debugging, and are invisible to request-shaped checks. The repository collects them so the next person loses minutes instead of an evening.

item.title: see through walls
item.description:
The Problem Real-time multiplayer AR typically breaks down when participants move behind physical obstacles—walls block line-of-sight, breaking spatial awareness. Existing solutions either require expensive infrastructure or fail to maintain a shared reference frame across devices. This repo demonstrates a practical fix using MultiSet’s Visual Positioning System (VPS) to align all devices to the same 3D map, then render avatars behind walls as glowing skeletons.

item.title: buzz
item.description:
